tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: The tables in the DataSocial TikTok warehouse: name, row count, what one row is, and what it holds.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: One table's columns with types and meanings, its sort key and coverage. Read it before writing SQL on a table.

tools.name: examples
tools.description: Worked examples (a question and SQL that runs here) and the SQL tips: growth maths, history-table patterns, big sound_history days. Pass a table to get only its examples.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Run one read-only ClickHouse SELECT on tiktok.* and get the rows back (at most 100 per request; 10 s per query). Name the columns you need and add a LIMIT.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "examples" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Worked examples (a question and SQL that runs here) and the SQL tips: growth maths, history-table patterns, big sound_history days, follows lookups. Pass a table to get only its examples." → after: "Worked examples (a question and SQL that runs here) and the SQL tips: growth maths, history-table patterns, big sound_history days. Pass a table to get only its examples."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
